title: AC1018 physical DICTIONARYWDFLT and PLACEHOLDER output proof

source.fixturePolicy: Used the existing local DWG. No DWG or DXF fixture was added.

formatEvidence.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
formatEvidence.relevantLayout: DICTIONARYWDFLT has DICTIONARY fields plus a hard-pointer default-entry field.

observed: Object type 500, handle 0x0E, DICTIONARYWDFLT class AcDbDictionaryWithDefault

independentSourceReader.decodedGraph: DICTIONARYWDFLT 0x0E is rooted by NOD ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME; its Normal entry and defaultId target PLACEHOLDER 0x0F. The dictionary owner/reactor is NOD 0x0C; the placeholder owner/reactor is dictionary 0x0E.

sourceProfile.dictionary: The unique DICTIONARYWDFLT has cloning 1, hardOwner 0, one Normal entry and default entry both targeting PLACEHOLDER 0x0F; its owner/reactor target NOD 0x0C.
sourceProfile.placeholder: The unique PLACEHOLDER 0x0F has owner/reactor DICTIONARYWDFLT 0x0E, with no extension dictionary, appData or extData.
sourceProfile.root: The NOD contains exactly one ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME entry for DICTIONARYWDFLT 0x0E.

qualifiedScope.graph: Frozen typed source records and source callback identities are compared at the original AC1018 version. The staged AC1024 output inspector checks unique remapped NOD, dictionary and placeholder identities; NOD key ownership; the DICTIONARYWDFLT Normal/default target; dictionary and placeholder owner/reactor roles; and the placeholder's exact raw owner/reactor fields. Only the two inspected callback identities are qualified after successful staged inspection.
qualifiedScope.readback: Fresh AC1024 import checks the typed DICTIONARYWDFLT and raw PLACEHOLDER pair, class counts, NOD root edge, default target, remapped ownership/reactor roles and placeholder fields.

failureAndRetry.negativeControl: Replace the source PLACEHOLDER reactor with NoHandle. Export rejects before destination replacement and leaves both callback qualification states unchanged.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore the reactor and retry on the same adapter. ASCII and Binary output succeed, fresh readback passes, and both source callbacks become output-qualified only after staged inspection.
failureAndRetry.sourceIsolation: The source contains unrelated invalid empty-name STYLE 0xDF. The physical AC1018 test renames only that in-memory test model to reach OBJECTS output; this does not qualify STYLE or whole-source conversion.

implementation.behavior: The existing dictionary-default output binding now freezes AC1018 or AC1024 source version independently from the AC1024 DXF target, applies source-version-aware equality and frame checks, and requires exact custom/standard callback roles before admission.

planImpact.callbackCensus: 9 of 23 source callback identities now have bounded output qualification across the prior admitted profiles and this pair; 14 remain unqualified.
planImpact.completedActionRemoved: Add AC1018 source-version-aware output binding and exact readback for DICTIONARYWDFLT 0x0E and PLACEHOLDER 0x0F.
planImpact.remaining: Resolve the invalid empty-name STYLE disposition and qualify the other required callbacks and dependencies. Strict whole-source conversion remains refused.

focusedSelectors.result: PASS for AC1018 source identity, ASCII/Binary output, output qualification, exact graph roles, fresh readback, atomic refusal and same-adapter retry
PASS for existing AC1024 source compatibility, ASCII/Binary output, exact graph roles, fresh readback, atomic refusal and same-adapter retry

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; the focused profile selectors were sufficient for this local output-binding slice.

limitations: This proves one source-bound AC1018 dictionary/default pair to AC1024 DXF profile only.
Fourteen of 23 AC1018 callback identities remain unqualified; strict whole-source conversion remains refused.
The test-only STYLE rename is not a production omission or replay policy.
Fresh libdxfrw readback and independent source decoding do not establish native CAD or 3D consumer semantics.
